description: This file contains unit tests for the CanvasWindowController functionality in a macOS application. It includes test cases for showing, hiding, and closing canvas and window controllers, utilizing Swift's XCTest framework annotations and asynchronous testing features.

methods.name: panel controller shows and hides
methods.description: Test method that verifies the showing and hiding of a panel-style CanvasWindowController, including adjusting placement and evaluating JavaScript asynchronously.

methods.name: window controller shows and closes
methods.description: Test method that verifies the showing and closing of a window-style CanvasWindowController, including responding to window close notification.
